plan.title: Create and publish a Price Based auction

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen required for auction strategy selection.
Set the event type to Auction and select the Price Based strategy.
Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Apply the first available auction template.
Add the required auction line item.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line item.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Save and publish the configured Price Based auction.
Assert that publication reached a real project page with an event id.
